title: Dispatch: olc5.7 engine applies feature/option proficiency grants (attempt 1)
description:
Engine consumption of typed proficiency grants for eshyra-olc5.7 (read its DESIGN field: decisions D2-D5 are this task; D1 pack typing already landed on this branch via eshyra-olc5.7.1: proficiency mechanics effects on feature records, and choices[].options[].mechanics.effects on feature-choice options, carry optional typed savingThrows (lowercase abilities), skills (canonical SRD skill names), armor ('light armor'|'medium armor'|'heavy armor'|'shields') beside the verbatim grant text). Effective profile: semantic-system (durable sheet state) inside rules-clause-complete.

CODE SURVEY (main a961fb0b):
- packages/core/src/character/rulesPackResolver.ts: ResolvedFeatureData (~L279) has key/name/source/level/choices only. Add readonly proficiencyGrants?: ProficiencyGrant where ProficiencyGrant = {savingThrows?: AbilityScoreName[]; skills?: string[]; armor?: string[]}, unioned over data.mechanics.effects[kind='proficiency'] typed fields (ignore effects without typed fields; validate shapes fail-closed like the other opt* parsers). Options already pass through verbatim in choices[].options; add a small helper to read an option's typed grant by option id.
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpEngine.ts: target features computed ~L884-891 (targetFeatureRefs), held features ~L892-907 (heldFeatureRefs); recomputeAfterChoices (~L1531-1580) rebuilds savingThrows from sheet.savingThrows[ability].proficient; applyChangeSetToSheet (~L1667-1730) writes skillProficiencies (applySkillProficienciesToSheet), languages, featureChoices (applyFeatureChoicesToSheet in levelUpFeatureChoices.ts ~L688, which handles fc.replaces), savingThrows.
- packages/core/src/character/finalizeCharacter.ts: CharacterSheet (~L318); finalizeCharacterDraft (~L430) builds the sheet (~L640-700): savingThrows from draft.derived, skillProficiencies via resolveProficiencySet, armorProficiencies from the class record, subclass + featureChoices from classFeatureState (~L704-725; Life Domain is chosen here at level 1). validateCharacterSheetRollEvidence -> validateCharacterSheetFeatureChoices (~L135) is where sheet shape validation for optional fields lives.
- Expertise source: characterExpertise(sheet) (used by skillBonuses.ts ~L91). College of Lore skill choices: levelUpSkillChoices.ts (must not regress). resolve_check: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolResolveCheck.ts reads sheet.savingThrows[ability].proficient (~L209) and deriveSkillBonuses(sheet) — NO change needed there; prove it end-to-end instead.

WHAT TO BUILD
1. New module packages/core/src/character/proficiencyGrants.ts (internal; export via @eshyra/core/internal only if tests need it): pure functions
   - grantsForSources(sources: {sourceRef, grant}[]): computes, against a sheet, what each source would NEWLY add (items the sheet already holds from any source are not added).
   - applyProficiencyGrants(sheet, sources) -> {sheet', ledgerEntries} : sets savingThrows[a].proficient=true (modifier recomputed = ability modifier + proficiencyBonus), appends skills (canonical spelling, case-insensitive dedupe against existing), appends armor (dedupe), and appends ledger entries {sourceRef, savingThrows?, skills?, armor?} containing ONLY what was added. A source that adds nothing still gets NO ledger entry? -> DECISION: record an entry with empty arrays omitted ({sourceRef} only) so reconciliation is idempotent and never re-evaluates that source; validate that.
   - removeOptionGrants(sheet, sourceRef): removes exactly the ledger entry's recorded skills/armor/saves for that sourceRef and drops the entry; refuses (throws a LevelUpEngineError-style error with a clear message) if a skill to remove is in characterExpertise(sheet).
   Source refs: feature key for features (e.g. 'feature:rogue:slippery-mind'); option id for options (e.g. 'eldritch-invocation:beguiling-influence').
2. CharacterSheet gains readonly proficiencyGrants?: readonly CharacterProficiencyGrant[] (doc comment: provenance of proficiencies added by class/subclass features and chosen options; legacy sheets omit it). Validate shape in the sheet validator path (array; sourceRef non-empty string unique across entries; arrays of strings within the vocabularies; no duplicates). Do NOT bump schemaVersion (optional field, existing pattern: featureChoices, spellcasting).
3. Level-up (one coherent pass, preview and apply consistent):
   a. After choices are applied, compute sources = every feature in heldFeatureRefs ∪ targetFeatureRefs with a typed grant, plus every option id present in the post-choice featureChoices whose option carries a typed grant. Sources already in sheet.proficiencyGrants are skipped (idempotent; this also RECONCILES legacy sheets created before the fix at their next level-up).
   b. Replacements (fc.replaces): if the replaced option id has a ledger entry, removeOptionGrants first (expertise conflict -> the level-up is refused, fail closed), then the incoming option is a new source.
   c. Saves: recomputeAfterChoices must use the post-grant proficiency so changeSet.savingThrows shows {from: not proficient, to: proficient} for Slippery Mind / Diamond Soul at preview. Skill/armor additions should be visible in the change set too (add readonly proficienciesGained?: {savingThrows?, skills?, armor?} and proficienciesRemoved? to LevelUpChangeSet, following existing optional-field style) so the player-facing preview shows them.
   d. applyChangeSetToSheet persists skills/armor/saves/ledger.
4. Creation: in finalizeCharacterDraft, after the sheet is built, apply grants for all level-1 class features, level-1 subclass features (Life Domain bonus proficiency) and level-1 chosen options, recording the ledger. Do not change behavior for characters with no such grants (no proficiencyGrants field emitted when no source has a typed grant).
5. Never remove a class save proficiency or a background/ancestry/class-chosen skill: only ledger-recorded additions are ever removed.

EVIDENCE (generalized; distinguish defective from repaired; place beside existing level-up / finalize / resolveCheck tests; use the real SRD pack via the existing test helpers):
 - Rogue 14->15: sheet.savingThrows.wisdom.proficient becomes true and modifier = WIS mod + PB; resolve_check saving_throw ability wisdom for that actor includes the proficiency term (end-to-end through the tool, as the r8en tests do). Assert the pre-fix state (level 14 sheet) is not proficient.
 - Monk 13->14: all six saves proficient; ledger records only the four previously non-proficient abilities.
 - Warlock choosing Beguiling Influence: Deception+Persuasion added and recorded; if Deception was already held (e.g. from background/class choice), only Persuasion is added/recorded and Deception survives a later replacement; replacing Beguiling Influence removes only the recorded skills and drops the entry; replacement refused when a recorded skill has expertise (construct the sheet state directly).
 - Life Domain cleric at creation: armorProficiencies includes 'heavy armor', ledger entry present; a non-Life cleric has neither.
 - Legacy reconciliation: a level-15 rogue sheet without proficiencyGrants and without Wisdom save proficiency gains it (and the ledger entry) at its 15->16 level-up; running reconciliation twice adds nothing.
 - Idempotency/duplication: no duplicate skills/armor/ledger entries across repeated level-ups.
 - College of Lore level-up skill picks unchanged (existing tests stay green).
 - Validator rejects malformed proficiencyGrants (duplicate sourceRef, unknown skill).
Keep tests proportionate: one focused test file for the module + targeted additions to existing level-up/creation suites; no test per SRD feature beyond the four named cases.
DO NOT: change resolve_check semantics; add mechanics for unrelated option prose (Devil's Sight etc. stay DM-adjudicated); touch importer/pack files (if the pack shape is insufficient, stop and report); touch freeze-manifest hashes or add thaw notes.
REPORT (bd notes): files changed, design decisions taken where the spec left latitude, test names, verify:worktree result.

ABSORBED FROM FILED FOLLOW-UPS (part of this task, not separate work):
 - eshyra-llrp: child .1 also typed three ANCESTRY trait grants (elf / high-elf Perception, half-orc Intimidation). Ancestry skills are already applied at creation by srdAncestrySkills.ts. Your engine sources are ONLY class/subclass feature records and feature-choice options; never read ancestry trait mechanics. Add one assertion that an elf's created sheet has exactly one 'Perception' entry and no proficiencyGrants entry for an ancestry source.
 - eshyra-fk9x: docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md} (generated by packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts) classifies the new typed paths data.mechanics.effects[].savingThrows[] / .armor[] / .skills[] (feature) and data.choices[].options[].mechanics.effects[].skills[] / .kind as 'model-adjudicated'. Once your engine consumes the feature and option typed fields, reclassify exactly those consumed feature/option paths as 'complete' in the inventory script's registry of complete paths (follow how other consumed paths cite their contract, e.g. 'srdCreationChoices.ts and featureChoices.ts'; cite proficiencyGrants.ts), regenerate the inventory, and leave the ancestry skills[] path model-adjudicated (no engine consumer). The grant text path stays source prose.

COMPLETION (commit 9f37fa8b, branch eshyra-olc5.7.2, not pushed). New proficiencyGrants.ts (grantsForSources, applyProficiencyGrants, removeOptionGrants, collectGrantSources, validator); resolver parseProficiencyGrants + ResolvedFeatureData.proficiencyGrants; CharacterSheet.proficiencyGrants ledger (validated, no schemaVersion bump); creation applies L1 class/subclass/option grants (no ledger emitted when none); level-up preview/apply compute gained/removed/ledger (changeSet.proficienciesGained/Removed/proficiencyLedger), saves recomputed in preview, legacy reconciliation, replacement removal with fail-closed Expertise refusal (LevelUpEngineError). Inventory: 7 consumed feature/option typed paths reclassified complete (ancestry skills[] stays model-adjudicated), regenerated. Tests: packages/core/test/proficiencyGrants.test.ts (13). Decisions: malformed typed effect contributes nothing; empty ledger dropped from sheet (field omitted); a source adding nothing records {sourceRef}; Expertise check uses post-choice featureChoices; newly picked subclass contributes only target-level features. verify:worktree passed (343 files, 6389 tests).
